title: Word counter is thrown off by extra spaces
summary: `word_count(text)` should return how many words are in the text, where words are separated by one or more spaces. Right now `word_count("hello   world")` returns `4` instead of `2`, and `word_count("")` returns `1` instead of `0`.
hint: Look at what `split` is given. Calling it with no arguments treats any run of spaces as one gap.
